major_cooldowns.name: Summon Darkglare
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pool Soul Shards and get Agony plus Corruption or Wither ticking, then summon it before you start chaining Unstable Affliction so its 20% dot amp covers their whole duration.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 205180 is the cast id and also shows as the player's Darkglare window aura in the sampled parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Dark Harvest
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown whenever its Soul Shards will not overcap you, and sync one into every Darkglare window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table base_cd_s is 60; the guide states Cull the Weak reduces it to roughly 40 seconds, so 40 is used here. 1257065 shares the name and was not observed as a cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Malevolence
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pair it with every Summon Darkglare and send the off minute cast as soon as it is up, since it adds 6 stacks to each active Wither.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Hellcaller capstone; 442726 is castable per its tooltip, 430014 shares the name and looks like the talent or buff. Neither was observed in the sampled parses, which were all Soul Harvester.

defensives.name: Unending Resolve
defensives.usage_rule: Press it into a big hit or heavy rot; it cuts the damage taken and keeps your casts from being interrupted.

defensives.name: Dark Pact
defensives.usage_rule: Shield yourself just before predictable raid damage instead of sitting on it.

defensives.name: Mortal Coil
defensives.usage_rule: Fear a nearby enemy for the instant self heal when you drop low and your bigger buttons are down.

defensives.name: Healthstone
defensives.usage_rule: Swallow it as your instant top up when a hit takes you low and the healers are busy.
defensives.id_note: Consumable created by Create Soulwell; not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

rules.description: Open with Agony, then Darkglare, then Unstable Affliction
rules.action: Get Agony ticking, summon Darkglare, then chain Unstable Affliction under it.

rules.description: Keep Agony up on the boss
rules.action: Reapply it as it enters its pandemic window, and refresh on the move rather than casting nothing.

rules.description: Keep Haunt up on your priority target
rules.action: Recast it the moment it comes off cooldown, on your priority target in AoE.

rules.description: Refresh Agony late, do not clip it
rules.action: Hold the refresh until it is inside its 4.5 second pandemic window.

rules.description: Malefic Grasp is your filler inside Darkglare
rules.action: Channel Malefic Grasp while Darkglare is out and save Drain Soul or Shadow Bolt for the rest of the fight.

rules.description: Press Dark Harvest below the shard cap
rules.action: Dump a shard or two into Unstable Affliction first so the 3 shards it grants are not wasted.
Fire Unstable Affliction the moment it procs, or Seed of Corruption when you are in AoE.

rules.description: Seed of Corruption on multiple targets
rules.action: Switch to Seed of Corruption from 2 targets as Soul Harvester and 3 as Hellcaller, keeping Agony on a handful of them.

rules.description: Pair Dark Harvest with Summon Darkglare
rules.action: Send Dark Harvest inside the same window so its damage and shards land under the dot amp.

source_summary: Affliction stacks its damage into the Summon Darkglare window: pool Soul Shards, get Agony and Corruption or Wither ticking, then summon Darkglare before chaining Unstable Affliction so its 20% dot amp covers every one. Dark Harvest goes out on its roughly 40 second cooldown whenever its shards will not overcap, with one synced into each Darkglare window, and Hellcaller pairs Malevolence with every Darkglare cast. Haunt and Agony stay up all fight, Malefic Grasp is the filler while Darkglare is out with Drain Soul or Shadow Bolt otherwise, and Seed of Corruption takes over once several enemies are up.
